name: NIU Holdings Limited
summary: WAC Holdings Limited operates as an engineering consultancy, delivering a full spectrum of structural and geotechnical engineering services throughout Hong Kong and Macau. The firm's structural expertise includes intricate loading calculations and stress design, while its geotechnical specialists focus on analyzing subsurface conditions and evaluating site-specific risks. Additionally, the company provides material engineering, offering guidance on the selection and appropriate use of construction materials for projects. Beyond these core services, WAC Holdings undertakes various infrastructure initiatives, such as road and drainage construction. They also supply registered structural engineers and authorized personnel for alteration and addition projects, alongside providing expert consultation services. Further offerings encompass computer-aided drawing preparation, comprehensive design and back-office support for construction, and equipment rental. Founded in 1987, the company maintains its headquarters in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong.
